tools.name: zenx_models_list
tools.description: Discover the current model IDs, supported reasoning efforts and defaults from the App Server model catalog.

tools.name: zenx_threads_configure
tools.description: Select an existing model and optional reasoning effort for a Thread. Discover choices using zenx_models_list; App Server validates availability and active-work constraints.

target.description: Full Thread ID, unique ID prefix, or exact title. Ambiguous targets return candidates without writing.

tools.name: zenx_projects_list
tools.description: List bounded workspace groupings derived from ZenX configuration and Thread cwd metadata. Projects are not runtime objects.

tools.name: zenx_threads_list
tools.description: List bounded App Server Threads, optionally filtered by workspace/cwd or a name, preview, and ID query.

cursor.description: Continue the same filters; list changes invalidate the cursor explicitly.

tools.name: zenx_threads_create
tools.description: Create an idle Thread through App Server thread/start with an explicit cwd and optional runtime settings.

project.description: Exact configured Project name or workspace path; use projects_list to discover.

tools.name: zenx_threads_read
tools.description: Read public Item projections of history. Default: latest turns; cursor reads older pages. Choose items or agent_messages, optionally within turnId. Choose item plus itemId for public_item_json chunks; concatenate content using nextCursor. Structured opaque values expose only identity and public summary at every depth. Public reasoning and tool output text are preserved. Previews are excerpts, never generated summaries.

workspace.description: Optional workspace path to disambiguate the target.

tools.name: zenx_threads_send
tools.description: Send a message to a Thread. Omit messageType to follow the saved ZenX sending preference; use follow_up to queue next work, guidance to supplement current work, or replacement to interrupt and change the task. The application handles message IDs and concurrent Turn checks.

target.description: Full Thread ID, unique ID prefix, or exact title. Ambiguous targets return candidates without writing.

workspace.description: Optional workspace path to disambiguate the target.

messageType.description: follow_up: do this after current work; guidance: add guidance to current work; replacement: interrupt current work and do this instead. Omit to use the saved ZenX send preference.

tools.name: zenx_self_control_workflows_get
tools.description: Read the user-scoped custom Slash workflows and title-generation prompt configured in ZenX Settings.

tools.name: zenx_self_control_workflows_update
tools.description: Replace the user-scoped custom Slash workflows and optional title prompt using the baseRevision from workflows_get. The built-in /compact command is reserved; omit titlePrompt or pass null to restore the default.

name: ZenX self-control
mainDocument: Use readable Thread targets and original-history cursors. Send target/text and optional follow_up, guidance or replacement intent; the app owns IDs and concurrency checks. Discover models/efforts and Projects before selecting. See README for pagination.
